content.short: oSnap enables off-chain voting via Snapshot and on-chain execution from a Safe, via UMA's Optimistic Oracle.
content.description: oSnap leverages the Optimistic Oracle to move governance workflows off-chain and execute proposals on-chain from a Safe treasury. By conducting voting off-chain in Snapshot and wiring the resulting approvals to on-chain transactions, it trims gas costs for DAO voters and lowers multisig signer bottlenecks in proposal execution. The underlying Oracle verifies real-world data on-chain, unlocking applications such as cross-chain bridging, insurance, derivatives, DAO governance, and prediction markets.
